subject: Sales discovery: model evals follow-up — multilingual (EU/APAC) next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@globexretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sales discovery: model evals follow-up — multilingual (EU/APAC) next steps

Hi Julia — great to meet earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our call: 

Summary of discussion:
- Primary use case: localized product Q&A and on-site search assistant for EU and APAC markets (focus initially on FR, DE, NL, JA, KO).
- Volume: ~150k queries/day at peak, with a high proportion of short prompts (<64 tokens) but some long-form returns for product descriptions.
- Success metrics: per-locale accuracy (top-1 intent), hallucination rate <1.5% on targeted prompts, latency SLO 300ms p50 for interactive flows.
- Compliance: data residency preference for EU customers; security team will send standard questionnaire.

Initial model fit & evaluation plan (recommended by Rishi):
- Candidate model families: Redwood-Open-1.3 (base), Redwood-Serve-1.0 (optimized for reduced latency), and a quantized Redwood-Optimize-1.0 variant for cost-sensitive routes.
- Benchmarks: we propose running a 2-week eval on your provided prompt set across FR/DE/JA/KO to measure per-locale RMSE/accuracy + hallucination regression vs your current baseline.
- Prompt handling: we'll test both normalized prompts (locale-specific tokenization) and locale-aware prompt templates to measure sensitivity.

What we can share right now (attached/links):
- Attached: globex_multilingual_prompt_sets.xlsx — the prompt buckets we discussed (sampled and anonymized).
- Drive: multilingual eval harness + example reports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDE-example
- Short summary report: multilingual_eval_summary_v1.pdf (attached).

Ask / next steps:
1) Confirm we have permission to run an eval on a locked subset of your anonymized prompts (we'll only store results, not raw inputs).
2) Share any locale-specific test data for NL or PT if you want those included (we didn't have PT on the call but can add).
3) Rishi will scope an evaluation plan and provide estimated token costs and ETA (goal: results within 10 business days of dataset receipt).
4) Security: please loop in sec@globexretail.com so we can start the questionnaire in parallel.

I can get a pilot plan (MVP: 1 model family x 4 locales, 10k prompts/locale) ready by EOD tomorrow once we have sign-off. Vivek — can you confirm the proposal for a 3-month pilot credit/discount structure we mentioned?

Thanks — looking forward to running these experiments.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: globex_multilingual_prompt_sets.xlsx, multilingual_eval_summary_v1.pdf

From: Julia Park <julia.park@globexretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Security <sec@globexretail.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: model evals follow-up — multilingual (EU/APAC) next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side: 

1) Permission to run eval: Yes, you have permission to run on anonymized prompts. We'll provide a subset (~12k prompts across the four locales) by EOD Monday.
2) Locale scope: Please include Portuguese (PT-BR) as well — we have a growing customer base in Brazil and want to compare outcomes. Apologies for not flagging earlier.
3) Data residency: our legal/privacy team prefers EU-resident processing for any EU customer data. We'll need to understand if Redwood can pin eval runs to eu-region capacity (or use a dedicated instance).
4) Quality/regression concerns: We've seen regression on PT outputs with another provider after a quantization change — we need clear regression testing and rollback criteria. Please detail how you would detect/regress.

I've looped in our security contact on cc. They'll send the SOC2 questionnaire and a short list of encryption/KMS questions.

Next steps for us: we will upload the prompt set + evaluation label sheet to the Drive link you shared and confirm access for rishi.malhotra@redwood.com.

Julia Park
Head of Personalization, Globex Retail
julia.park@globexretail.com
+44 20 7946 0012

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@globexretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, IT Security <sec@globexretail.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: model evals follow-up — multilingual (EU/APAC) next steps

Perfect — thanks Julia. Quick replies inline and concrete next steps: 

1) PT-BR: added to scope. Rishi will update the eval matrix to include PT-BR parity checks.
2) EU processing: we support region-pinned eval runs on our Dedicated/EU infra; for hosted runs we can route evaluation traffic through EU capacity and provide an audit log. I'll have our infra note the specific option and a short SOW for EU-resident processing.
3) Regression detection & rollback: proposed approach from Rishi (summary):
   - Baseline: capture existing baseline model outputs for your labeled test set.
   - Canary eval: run candidate model on 10% sample to check top-line metrics (accuracy, hallucination).
   - Delta thresholds: automatic flag if accuracy drops >1.0% or hallucination increases >0.5% per-locale.
   - Automatic rollback/fallback: traffic routed to baseline model variant if flagged, with alerting to your team.

4) Access & timeline: please add rishi.malhotra@redwood.com to the Drive folder; once he has access we'll kick off the harness. ETA: 8 business days for initial eval summary after dataset is ingested.

5) Pilot credits: Vivek confirms internally but tentatively proposing a 50% pilot discount on serving costs for the first month + waived onboarding for this POC. Vivek?

I'll upload an updated eval plan and the prompt templates (globex_multilingual_prompt_sets_v2.xlsx) to the Drive and paste the link here when done. Also including a short checklist for security so your team knows what to expect.

Thanks again — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

—
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform
